ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a contrast ratio of approximately 0.15:1 white-to-black pixels, driven by localized scarring and organisms.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark gray to black contiguous base; spatial mapping reveals high-intensity linear filaments concentrated in the right lobe and several circular white-bordered rings (0.5% area) in the lower-left fluke quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, symmetrical V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior pixel angle of 130 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 8% of the fluke's total height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency micro-peaks; includes a significant anomalous semi-circular indentation (high-amplitude valley) on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-convex trajectory along the trailing edge with lobes tapering to sharp, upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of 4-6 distinct high-contrast circular ring-scars located on the mid-left lobe; significant white pixel clusters at distal tips representing crustacean colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High density of multi-directional, high-intensity linear rake marks (scratches) concentrated on the central and right lobe surfaces, cutting across the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable deep notch/tear on the right trailing edge; extensive stalked barnacle (Cirripedia) clusters covering the distal points of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Bright yellowish-white barnacle clusters on the extreme lateral tips providing a distinct textural and color contrast against the dark fluke surface.
